title: Spread it out or cram it in?

probes.question: Which study plan favours long-term memory?
options: One long session the night before
Several sessions spread over days or weeks

probes.question: Learning more by spreading study out in time is called the ____ effect.

image.alt: An open ring-binder planner showing a weekly page with Monday to Sunday lined sections.

body.question: In a 2006 review of memory studies, spaced practice was compared with massed practice (cramming) in 271 cases. How often did spaced practice come out ahead?
options: About two thirds of the time
body.reveal: Spaced practice beat massed practice in 259 of 271 cases. The gains are especially large when the gaps between sessions are days or weeks.
